import sys

class TaskC:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sum = [0] * 105
        self.pw = [0] * 105
        self.OK = False

    def solve(self, w, m):
        p = 1
        mx = 0
        for i in range(100):
            self.sum[i + 1] = p + self.sum[i]
            self.pw[i] = p
            p *= w
            if p > 1 << 40:
                mx = i
                break
        else:
            mx = 99
        self.process(0, m, mx)
        print("YES" if self.OK else "NO")

    def process(self, cur, target, pos):
        if cur == target:
            self.OK = True
            return
        remaining = self.sum[pos + 1]
        next_val = self.pw[pos]

        if cur - remaining > target or cur + remaining < target:
            return
        else:
            if cur + self.sum[pos] < target:
                self.process(cur + next_val, target, pos - 1)
            elif cur - self.sum[pos] > target:
                self.process(cur - next_val, target, pos - 1)
            else:
                self.process(cur, target, pos - 1)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    solver = TaskC()
    solver.solve(w, m)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
